# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> Mc Peake Auctioneers are thrilled to bring 20 Brindley Park Road to the market. This is a fabulous 2 bed mid terrace spanning a generous 71 Sqm, Located in a small horseshoe cul del sac. Ideally located within walking distance to numerous bus stops and Ashbourne town centre, local school campus, GAA grounds, this property is bright and airy with well-appointed accommodation.
